summary: ERA states a $150,000 investment on a post-money SAFE for 6%. Alumni capital raised and market capitalization in the same quote are not the investment and are not a return.
formattedTerms:
ERA invests $150,000 on a post-money SAFE in return for 6% of each company.

The companies selected to participate in the four-month program will receive an initial investment of $150K on a 6% post-money SAFE and the potential for follow-on funding.

Since its founding in 2011, ERA alumni companies have raised more than $2.5 billion in investor capital and collectively exceed $10 billion in market capitalization.
